headline: One Night Only: Tech-Enforced Sex Dystopia
summary: New film 'One Night Only' depicts a unique dystopian premise. Single people can only have sex one night a year in modern New York. It's not a traditional romantic comedy, focusing on its absurd tech-enforced rule.

headline: Meta ordered to pay an additional $567 million in public nuisance ruling
summary: Meta fined an additional $567 million in a New Mexico child safety case. Total charges against Meta now approach $1 billion. Court ruled Meta's platforms significantly contribute to teen mental health issues.

headline: Trevor Noah is hosting Google’s Pixel 11 launch event
summary: Comedian Trevor Noah will host Google's upcoming Pixel 11 launch event. The 'Made by Google' hardware event is scheduled for August 12th. Other celebrities and influencers are also expected to participate.

headline: Jony Ive’s first OpenAI gadget is reportedly a hockey puck-sized smart speaker
summary: Jony Ive and OpenAI are reportedly developing a hockey puck-sized smart speaker. The battery-powered device is described as a 'smart speaker without a display'. It's rumored to launch in 2027 with a price over $300.

headline: Target is Slicing Open Pokémon Card Boxes Before They're Sold in a Bid to Deter Scalpers, Fans Say
summary: Target is reportedly cutting the shrink wrap on new Pokémon card boxes. This aims to deter scalpers who buy stock in bulk for resale. Fans report the practice to combat market manipulation.

headline: The Last House Review
summary: Review for Netflix's new film, 'The Last House'. Louis Leterrier directed this haphazard lockdown thriller. The review provides an assessment of the movie's quality.

headline: Will Wight's Cradle Series Is a Must-Read for Anime Fans Who Just Discovered Their Love of LitRPG
summary: Will Wight's 'Cradle Series' is highly recommended for LitRPG enthusiasts. It's particularly suited for anime fans new to the genre. The series offers an engaging entry point for discovering LitRPG.

headline: Layoffs Hit Staff at Crossfire Developer That’s No Moon
summary: That's No Moon, developer of 'Crossfire,' has announced layoffs. An undisclosed number of staff have been impacted. This adds to a continuing trend of layoffs within the gaming industry.

headline: I was standing in front of my teacher when she was shot, Thai pupil says
summary: A Thai pupil recounts witnessing their teacher shot during a school attack. The student escaped by climbing over a school fence. The shooting tragically resulted in the death of five teachers.

headline: Officer who led PC Harper investigation 'appalled' killers could be released early
summary: Former Det Sup Stuart Blaik is 'appalled' by the potential early release of PC Harper's killers. Blaik led the investigation into the police officer's death. He publicly shared his strong views on the case for the first time.

headline: England footballer Ivan Toney charged with assault at Soho nightclub
summary: England footballer Ivan Toney has been charged with assault. The incident reportedly occurred at a Soho nightclub. The 30-year-old former Brentford striker is due to appear in court next month.

headline: Arrests in Norfolk town as disorder continues for third night
summary: Arrests have been made in a Norfolk town following ongoing disorder. Disturbances are linked to anti-immigration protests. The town has experienced unrest for a third consecutive night.
